g.text: 7 · Robot modes (state machine on the Pi)
dashed border = new in Jero (upstream has pause only, no fall detection) · reported in telemetry as `mode`
• Gamepad input always wins over the link, in every mode.
• Link lost: commands decay to zero within the TTL, so Walking → Standing on its own.
• Skills only start from Standing; the executor waits for 'standing' in telemetry.
• Policy switching (stand / dance policies, later) happens only in Standing.
